# App icon

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Build and install · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/ui/favicon.svg, site/favicon.svg, scripts/make-icon.py draws assets/icon.ico (16 to 256 px) and assets/icon.png from the favicon's mark; scripts/package-desktop.mjs passes it to the packager and the installer; both windows use it

## What is missing

the icon on an installed copy has not been looked at on a real Windows PC
